text:
Revenants
​
Introduction
Revenants are a popular type of Wilderness monster which may be found in the Forinthry Dungeon. They're mainly killed for the Chaos Elemental collection log, Wilderness collection log, and the Revenant Spirit which is used to unlock the Revenant pet as well as its skins; this drop gets increasingly rarer the more skins you have.
​
⬥ After the Wilderness update killing revenants became substantially safer, as players can now opt-out of PvP.
⬥ Using a Forinthry bracelet  will make revenants NOT be aggressive.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This effect will persist for an hour and only count down while in the Forinthry Dungeon.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Even if it was used years ago, the effect may still be active.
​
Stats
⬥  level: 1
⬥  XP per kill: Varies
⬥ Optimal kills per hour: ~730  (Active), ~400  (Low Effort)
⬥ Optimal  XP per hour: Varies
​
Desirable drops
⬥ Ancient Warriors' equipment
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Notable drops:
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Statius's warhammer 
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Zuriel's staff 
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Zuriel's robe top 
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Zuriel's robe bottom 
⬥ Revenant Spirit 
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Unlocks the next unowned Revenant pet, gets rarer the more skins you have unlocked.
​
Useful Items and Unlocks


















Owning the following increases the efficiency of your sessions, but is by no means mandatory.

Items
⬥ Revenant drop enhancer 
    • 10% increase to the revenant drop table, except 
⬥ Salve amulet (e) 
    • Damage increase helps one-shot potential, and accuracy increase is useful for high level revenants.
⬥ Ghost hunter equipment 
    • Wear 3 pieces for a 10% damage increase.
⬥ Dwarven siege engine 
    • Extremely strong in combination with  and , allowing it to kill revenants on its own.
    • Make sure to have the Restocking Cannon ability unlocked.
Other
⬥ Elite Wilderness achievements 
    • 5% increased chance to get Ancient Warriors' equipment, stacks with 
⬥ Stone of Jas buff 
    • 3% damage increase for 4 hours after visiting the cave.
⬥ Undead Slayer 
    • Wear a piece of augmented power armour with this perk.








​
Location and How to Get there
⬥ Revenants are located in the Forinthry Dungeon.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The quickest way to get there is via the  Forinthry Dungeon teleport.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Alternatively you may use the  and run west to the level 17 Wilderness entrance.
​
Method: Active Magic
The active Magic  method consists of killing revenants using Legacy Combat Mode one at a time following specific routes, this can be replicated using Melee  with an augmented Revenant bane 2h sword 
​
⬥ The knight and dragon are the fastest spawning revenants; use routes that prioritise killing them as soon as they respawn, as they have the highest drop rates for uniques.
​

⬥  is positioned to kill the southern revenant goblins and imp, occasionally being able to kill the pyrefiend, and lowering the dark beast and demon such that they can be consistently one-shot.
​

⬥ Red and green: Main routes to take when killing revenants between knight and dragon spawns.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• When going from knight to dragon, kill 3-5 revenants. When going from dragon to knight, kill 2-3 revenants.
⬥ Blue and yellow: Potential detour routes for red and green routes respectively depending on revenant movement.
​

Method: Low Effort Magic
The low effort Magic  method consists of killing revenants using Legacy Combat Mode to AFK until they are no longer aggressive. When this happens you will follow a specific route killing revenants along the way in order to reset their aggro.
​

⬥  will solo kill the dragon.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You AFK kill the dark beast, ork, demon, cyclops, pyrefiend, and 2 goblins.
​

⬥ Every ~10 minutes follow the route shown above: take the outer loop to the dragon → knight → dragon → start.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Make sure to reach the marked northwesternmost tile in order to properly reset aggro.
